"A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; as I have loved you." — John 13:34

#MaundyThursday #HolyWeek #Scripture #ChristianLife #FaithDaily

#MaundyThursday #HolyWeek #Gethsemane #Scripture #FaithLife

#GoodFriday #HolyWeek #Scripture #ChristianFaith #FaithDaily

His first words from the cross were a prayer for the people hurting Him. That is the kind of love that changes everything.

#GoodFriday #HolyWeek #Luke23 #Scripture #ChristianLife

"My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?" — Matthew 27:46

#GoodFriday #HolyWeek #TheCross #Scripture #ChristianFaith

"It is finished." — John 19:30

#GoodFriday #HolyWeek #John19 #TheCross #Scripture #FaithLife

"He was laid in a tomb." — Luke 23:53

Tonight the stone is in place. The disciples don't know yet. But God is never more at work than when everything looks finished.

Rest in that. Full sleep episode in the bio. Goodnight. 🕊️

#GoodFriday #HolyWeek #ChristianSleep #DivineSleep #SleepWithGod #Scripture

"Be still, and know that I am God." — Psalm 46:10

Holy Saturday is the day of silence. The disciples waited not knowing the end of the story. Sometimes faith is just staying in the room when nothing makes sense yet.

#HolySaturday #HolyWeek #Psalm46 #Scripture #FaithDaily

"Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning." — Psalm 30:5

They didn't know the morning was coming. You do. Hold on.

#HolySaturday #HolyWeek #Psalm30 #Scripture #ChristianHope

"I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in Me, though he may die, he shall live." — John 11:25

He said this before the proof. Before the empty tomb. Faith is believing the promise before the morning arrives.

#HolySaturday #HolyWeek #John11 #Scripture #ChristianFaith

"The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He makes me to lie down in green pastures." — Psalm 23:1-2

In the waiting, He is still your Shepherd. He leads even in the valley. Even on the quiet Saturdays.

#HolySaturday #HolyWeek #Psalm23 #Scripture #DivinePeace

"I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the LORD, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope." — Jeremiah 29:11

Tomorrow changes everything. Rest tonight knowing He already knows the end of your story — and it is good.

Sunday is coming. Full episode in the bio. Goodnight. 🕊️
